actors.name: Gerald
actors.private_context: Gerald is the landlord. He proposed a 9% rent increase. He wants to maximize rental income but is aware of market conditions and vacancy costs. He knows Amara has been a reliable tenant for four years.

actors.name: Amara
actors.private_context: Amara is the tenant. She wants to hold the increase to 4%. She has paid on time for four years and knows comparable units list about 5% above her current rent. Her lease lapses at the end of next month.

shared_context: The building has two vacant units. Comparable one-bedrooms nearby list about 5% above Amara's current rent. Gerald proposed a 9% increase; Amara countered at 4%. They are negotiating a renewal figure before the lease ends on 2026-08-31.

starting_events.description: Amara has received Gerald's proposal of a 9% increase and has communicated her counter of 4%. No agreement has been reached yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows a signed lease renewal at a figure between 4% and 9% inclusive before 2026-08-31T23:59:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
